name: Salmon, Asparagus and Potato Traybake

components.name: Lemon Garlic Salmon
steps: Mash garlic with lemon, oil, oregano, pepper and salt and spread over salmon fillets.
Put the salmon on the same or a separate tray for 12-18 minutes; check 63 C in thickest portion, and add parmesan to vegetables toward the end.
Divide salmon, potatoes, asparagus and tomato into five containers. Cool and refrigerate quickly; reheat salmon gently to avoid drying.

components.name: Roasted Potatoes
steps: Set oven to 215 C and roast halved potatoes with measured oil and salt on a shallow tray for 25-30 minutes until almost tender.

components.name: Roasted Asparagus & Tomatoes
steps: When potatoes are nearly cooked, add asparagus and cherry tomatoes to a second tray, tossing the asparagus with any marinade remaining that has not touched raw salmon.
